Doctor_Bio_Home: My page is dedicated to women's health. I created it so our women, girls and mothers-to-be can get reliable, useful and interesting information about their health. I want to share my knowledge and experience and give you information based on the latest achievements of evidence-based medicine.
Testimonial_1_Text: Dr. Tamar was incredibly supportive throughout my high-risk pregnancy. Her competence gave me confidence at every stage.
Testimonial_2_Text: The option of an online consultation was a lifesaver in the third trimester. Fast, professional and reassuring every time.
Testimonial_3_Text: From the first visit to delivery, I felt fully cared for. The whole team is absolutely exceptional.
Cta_Home_Desc: Book your first visit and get expert care from day one.
Services_Section_Subtitle: From the first trimester to the postpartum period — we're by your side every step of the way.
About_Hero_Desc: My page is dedicated to women's health. I created it so our women, girls and mothers-to-be can get reliable, useful and interesting information about their health. I want to share my knowledge and experience and give you information based on the latest achievements of evidence-based medicine, so you can see a doctor in time and protect your health and the health of your loved ones.
Bio_Paragraph_1: Dr. Tamuna Tevzadze graduated with honors from Tbilisi State Medical University and completed her residency in obstetrics and gynecology at the "Clinic". She later received a fellowship in maternal-fetal medicine at the University of Vienna, Austria.
Bio_Paragraph_2: Over her 15-year career, she has developed particular expertise in managing high-risk pregnancies, gestational diabetes, pre-eclampsia and fetal growth disorders. She is committed to an evidence-based yet deeply human approach — ensuring every patient feels heard, informed and supported.
Bio_Paragraph_3: Beyond her clinical work, Dr. Tamar is actively involved in medical education, mentoring residents and publishing research in peer-reviewed journals on perinatal outcomes in the South Caucasus region.
Bio_Paragraph_4_Part1: Today, Dr. Tamar Tevzadze practices at the
Bio_Paragraph_4_Part2: clinic, where she offers patients full obstetric and gynecological care — from consultation visits through delivery.
Credentials_Section_Desc: Academic excellence and continuous professional development are the foundation of every consultation.
Credential_2_Detail: National Center for Maternal and Child Health · 2007–2011
Specialization_1_Text: Comprehensive monitoring and intervention for hypertension, diabetes, multiple pregnancies or fetal abnormalities.
Specialization_2_Text: Advanced ultrasound studies, Doppler imaging and biophysical profiling to assess fetal development at every stage.
About_Cta_Desc: Book your first consultation and experience care built on expertise, compassion and evidence.
